consumer: The frontend inventory panel that reads avatar.carried_items[] and asks 'what top-level items is the player holding?' to display them, with no engine condition/mission/dialogue check consuming the value.
scope: only the character's own carried items, top-level (wielded/worn/inventory stacks), NOT recursed into container contents and NOT items reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items emits a straight projection of the avatar's wielded_items(), worn, and inv_const_slice() stacks (type_id/name/charges/location) into snapshot JSON without filtering, coloring, or lag, so the authority is the raw carried-item world state itself, not a computed predicate or display proxy.
divergence: Avatar wields a knife, wears a backpack containing a sewing kit, and carries a canteen with 3 charges of water: a wrong answer that recursed into the backpack via visit_internal would list the sewing kit (not a top-level held item), and one that re-derived possession via condition.cpp::set_has_items would answer a yes/no rather than enumerate the actual carried stacks or the canteen's 3 charges.
